integrity: The entire Fourier series, all parameter ranges, and consecutive transition claims have analytic proofs. Included computations are finite supplementary diagnostics, not infinite certificates. Priority is best-knowledge, and the result has no external audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the two-component equal-scale, nonnegative mixing family on a unit geodesic circle. It does not preserve the Matérn-5/2 differentiability; at the sharp boundary finitely many Fourier characters are absent. No claim in higher sphere dimensions, signed weight extension, or uniqueness among all circular covariance repairs.
title: Sharp Laplace repair and an unbounded spectral staircase for a geodesic Matérn mixture on the circle
